_comment: The DEFINITION of the production bin grid: the parameters it is derived with, the corpus it is derived from, and a content digest of the result. This file is the single source of those parameters -- helix.data.bins reads its defaults here, and scripts/derive_coeff_bins.py takes its argparse defaults from those, so the numbers live in one place.
name: coeff_bins_r2_run0027575715_noisy

corpus._basis_digest_note: Checkable BEFORE deriving, and catches the pre-tau/r1 confusion. It does NOT identify which run: basis_digest hashes the DSP recipe, so all eight r1 runs share it.

_note: Training is noisy-only, so the grid bins the NOISY coefficients (one bin spans the sub-threshold gap). Not yet derived for r2: scripts/derive_coeff_bins.py --corpus <r2>/run_0027575715 writes it, and its digests go here.
